subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

10, 20, 11, 22, 14, 26, 19, 32, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Alternate addition series pattern is followed here.

 
• Consecutive odd number series are added alternatively starting with the first number.
 
• Consecutive even number series are added alternatively starting with the second number. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68a195785460b59731e79feb93674f0309c8a1982f19279f8683f20feaabdf3b.png] 

Hence, **"26"** is the correct answer.
